GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 1-2l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little, kept on one pace # disappointing
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 Lengths 1600m 3rd rail 2 Lengths 1200m 3rd 2 Lengths 800m 3rd 2 Lengths home turn Under Pressure 4th rails run Straight Kept Going Too Well # every ch/too strong
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Lengths 1600m 5th 6 Lengths 1200m 4th 4 Lengths 900m Went Forward Outside Leader home turn Hard Ridden 2nd Kept Going Ok final 200m # one paced run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped a runner. Passing the winning post on the first occasion, was steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward Settled Down 3rd 2 Lengths 1400m 5th 4 Lengths 800m 4th 3 Lengths 600m Hooked Out 3 Wide Went Forward home turn 1st kicked away 300m Middle Of Track Straight Kept Going Too Well # good ride/win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stewards permitted rider to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 55kg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well making steady ground # ran on from last

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & improving Two Wide @ 550m & pushed to quicken 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 300m & outsprinted in last 200m. # One-paced.
Jumped Fair bustled, sat rail 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, battled on well with limited room, need to see again # inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned in respect to her riding in the home straight and whether there was an opportunity to improve to the inside of rnr near 300m App. stated that she had endeavoured to obtain a run to the outside of rnr between that runner and anthr rnr however when improving to the outside of rnr heels run had closed resulting in her being disappointed. She further added that to continue momentum she continued out to obtain clear running as she was established to the outside of rnr’s heels which had also began weakening.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & chased steadily in last 150m. # Sound effort.
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3rd 3 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5th trailing 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved only marginally in Straight # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was reminded to ride her mounts out fully to the finishing line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, took over passing 100m and drew clear # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was bumped and became unbalanced passing the 150m. A  post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
